name: personalized-dietary-platform
description: Personalized Dietary Assessment Platform - Monorepo Launcher

scripts.dev: concurrently -k --prefix "[{name}]" --names "AI,API,WORKER,WEB" -c "cyan,green,yellow,magenta" "cd ai-service/food_api && python -m uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001 --reload" "cd backend/nutriplatform && python manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000" "cd backend/nutriplatform && python manage.py run_ai_worker" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
